findings.desc: doc-code-drift: README.md line 133 comment for run-selfchecks.mjs says '(6)' selfchecks, but this diff adds live-engine-selfcheck.mjs as the 7th entry in SELFCHECKS array (verified in run-selfchecks.mjs). The selfcheck count in the README inline comment is wrong by 1.

doc-code-drift: README.md line 101 (run-driver section) says 'the real campaign plugs a run-recovery.mjs adapter as the engine', but this diff introduces live-engine.mjs as the dedicated pluggable engine adapter for the real campaign. live-engine.mjs is not mentioned anywhere in README.md. The statement now mis-identifies the adapter and the README omits the new module entirely.

experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs:331, experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs:216, experiments/recovery-runner/adjudicate.mjs:254: scenario cells use the post-injection hidden failure as the hiddenRegression baseline, then adjudicate recovered from acceptancePass && hiddenRegressionPass. Trigger verified with a no-LLM A2prime/B1 median stub that shipped the same visible-pass hidden-failing injected fault: acceptancePass=true, hiddenRegressionPass=true, adjudicatedOutcome=recovered. This overcounts unresolved injected faults as recovery.

experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs:232, experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs:275, experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs:364: processEvents/permEvents are harvested only from arm.lastExec, which is overwritten on each retry. Trigger verified with a no-LLM A2 cell whose first attempt emitted processEvents=[git push origin main] and failed acceptance, then second attempt succeeded without processEvents: final record was recovered and unsafeChecks.destructiveCmd=false. Earlier real unsafe actions can evade capture and be scored safe.

experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs:286, experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs:410, experiments/recovery-runner/live-engine.mjs:465, experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs:428: the default run-driver --engine live-engine.mjs path constructs makeLiveEngine() with no A2prime budgets. Trigger verified with a no-LLM A2prime stub using default/no budgets: record emitted budgetPass=true, tokenInBand=true, wallInBand=true, tokenBudget=0, wallBudgetMs=0 while tokensSpent=100 and no truncation occurred. The powered A2prime arm would not be token/wall matched to A4.

A3 arm "reported-not-iterated" semantics unverified in selfcheck: the selfcheck only exercises A3 with correct+reviewerShips=true (clean path). Two concept-critical A3 behaviors have no assertion: (a) A3 + reviewer BLOCK => outcome is `recovered` (not safe-stop), confirming "findings reported, not iterated" does NOT gate the §6 adjudicated outcome; (b) A3 + acceptance-fail-all-retries => reviewer still called unconditionally. Without these assertions the A3 arm loop contract is untested for its distinguishing edge cases.
